note: D-SINK-17. hostPortOf / host_port_of and the two things that render their output: the Sources row's host (sourceView) and its default label (deriveLabel). ONE fixture, both languages, because the defect was a regex that existed twice and was wrong twice. The userinfo of a URL ends at the LAST at-sign in the authority; a password or a username containing one is legal and both parsers that matter (urllib, and this file's own validateSourceUrl) read it that way.
